sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Correct the first A_w >= A_L SPARQL comparison for units: nltl:shearArea is reported in unit:M2, while the formula result is in cm2 because of the 10000 factor. Convert the derived expected A_L and its tolerance to m2 before comparing with ?aw (or otherwise perform an equivalent unit-consistent comparison). Scale the tolerance from that converted expected result and retain the inclusive pass condition ?aw >= expectedAL_m2 - tolerance. The member-level requiredLongitudinalFrameShearArea comparison may remain in cm2 with its existing inclusive tolerance. Preserve the required hasStructuralMember minCount 1, the corrected b1*s operand, and the piecewise tolerance construction.
